bio.text: Kenneth Paschal, a Republican, has represented District 73 in the Alabama House of Representatives since July 14, 2021, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
According to Ballotpedia, he lives in Pelham, Alabama, and served in the U.S. Army for 21 years, reaching the rank of first sergeant.
His career includes work as governmental affairs director of the Alabama Family Rights Association, and he founded Bridge the Gap.
